hero.subline: A peer-to-peer skill network that connects students with domain experts whose identity has been independently verified.

assurance.heading: Trust you can check, not just read

items.title: Every Teacher is reviewed by a domain expert
items.body: Skill evidence and teaching plans are assessed by experts in the matching domain before a Teacher can publish a class.

items.title: Verification decisions are recorded immutably
items.body: Each submission is timestamped and kept as-is, so every approval and rejection stays traceable across versions.

items.title: 1 Credit = 1,000 VND
items.body: Direct 1:1 conversion with no hidden markup and no slippage on top-ups or withdrawals.

items.title: 90% to the Teacher, 10% platform fee
items.body: The Teacher keeps 90% of every completed class; the platform takes a flat 10% for verification and operations.

items.title: Payment is held until completion
items.body: The learner's payment stays in the platform ledger and only moves to the Teacher's wallet once the class is recorded as completed. Every transaction carries a trace ID.

withdrawal.body: The payout gateway integration is still in progress. The backend has not shipped this feature yet, so you cannot submit a withdrawal request at this time. Please come back after the backend ships it.
withdrawal.rulesBody: Once the feature ships: the withdrawal amount cannot exceed your available balance. When you submit the request, credits move to a payout_hold state and stay locked while the gateway reconciles. If the gateway rejects the payout, the held credits are returned to your wallet immediately.
